title: Pixel-art crystal cave wall with glowing gems
purpose: Generate a tileable pixel-art cave wall at a chosen art resolution: lumpy rock shaded from a top-left light, clusters of faceted pencil-shaped crystals with lit and dark faces, glints and outlines, and a glow halo on the rock, with an emissive map plus per-pixel normal, height, roughness and occlusion maps.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python pixel_crystal_cave.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: art_pixels
parameters.meaning: Art pixels along each side of the tile; the maps enlarge them with nearest-neighbour sampling.

parameters.name: clusters
parameters.meaning: Share of the evenly spread cluster positions that hold crystals.

parameters.name: crystal_length
parameters.meaning: Typical crystal length in art pixels.

parameters.name: glow
parameters.meaning: Strength of the glow halo on the rock around the crystals.

parameters.name: lumps
parameters.meaning: Size of the rock lumps: noise cells across the tile.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: Strength of the per-pixel normal map.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo and the glow in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Amethyst clusters glowing violet in dark purple-grey rock.

presets.name: ice_blue
presets.description: Long pale-blue ice crystals in cold blue-grey rock.

presets.name: emerald
presets.description: Short green emeralds scattered in brown-black rock.

presets.name: fire_ruby
presets.description: Red-orange crystals with a strong warm glow in charred rock.

limits: A still frame of stylized pixel art; the glow does not pulse or light the scene. The light from the top left is baked into the rock tones and crystal faces. Crystals are flat five-sided polygons with two faces, not modelled prisms, and on a 16-pixel grid they shrink to a few pixels. Rock lumps come from fractal noise. Emission strength is set in the engine; the map holds colour only. Output sizes that are not a whole multiple of art_pixels give art pixels of unequal widths. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate posterized to eighths.
technique_references: Posterized slope lighting of a periodic height field
Signed distance to a polygon for crystal rasterization
Face shading by the side of the crystal axis
Poisson-disc sampling on a torus for clusters
Ordered dithering for the outer glow ring
